chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad, from his uncle ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ṣalt, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Bint Ilyās, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: When death came to ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, he lost consciousness; then he opened his eyes.
And he recited: “When the Occurring Event occurs,” and, “Indeed, We have granted you a clear victory.”

And he said: “All praise is due to Allah, Who has fulfilled His promise to us and made us inherit the earth; we may settle in Paradise wherever we wish. Excellent indeed is the reward of those who labor.”
Then he passed away at that very hour and did not say anything further.

key_terms.أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ: the reward of those who act; the recompense of the righteous doers
key_terms.أُغْمِيَ: he lost consciousness; a fainting or swooning state
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise; the abode of eternal reward
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: all praise; complete praise and gratitude due to Allah
key_terms.الْوَاقِعَةُ: the Inevitable Event; the great event of the Hereafter
key_terms.الْوَفَاةُ: death; the moment of departing this worldly life
key_terms.فَتَحْنَا: We granted victory; a divine bestowal of clear triumph
key_terms.وَعْدَهُ: His promise; Allah’s true promise to His servants

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام say at the time of his death?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the final moments of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, portraying his passing as accompanied by Qur’anic recitation and words of praise to Allah. It highlights serenity at death, the fulfillment of Allah’s promise, and the hope of Paradise, reflecting the spiritual rank of the Imam عليه السلام.
